title: Local Governance saved-document replacement: current-head review and held recovery
goal: Understand the implemented local replacement workflow without treating historical digests, metadata, a saved source or source-only documentation as current freshness, independent approval, activation, mounted authoring access or customer acceptance.
prerequisites: Internal local-source preview only. Actual DEV wrapper remains records-read-only/narrow execution-limit identity; replacement is not registered through that wrapper. Do not remount or enable flags.
For the separately composed broad identity only: current desktop-session policy:manage and deliberately loaded historical document evidence. Historical rows identify target, not CAS authority.
Supplement to separate execution-limits guide and historical replacement design. No raw oldbody or all-Governance/control/backend/native coverage.
permissions: Current server reader/session/workspace authority required for stored head metadata; upload separately requires policy management. Both routes default OFF unless enabled server-side; no current environment value was read.

POST read_document_head sends only artifactDigest; server derives tenant/name/scope from stored artifact and validates head/blob/history in one transaction. No caller-typed version/name or permission grant.
Private source storage is not baseline proposal, independent review, activation, enrollment or provider execution; checkbox is local file/target review only.

steps.instruction: Choose a historical saved policy document in the separate local broad-identity composition.
steps.expectedState: Target dropdown identifies fixed name/exact scope/historical digest, does not load automatically; actual Settings wrapper does not expose it.
Saved artifact is validated first; fixed read operation sends artifactDigest only and echoes must match. Failure/OFF503 leaves save disabled, no initial-upload fallback.

steps.instruction: Review current-head metadata and original last-update time.
steps.expectedState: Content-digest equality is not old snapshot freshness/current version; no original body/fact arrays returned, version999 is read-only.

steps.instruction: Choose a bounded local replacement text/Markdown file.
steps.expectedState: Nonempty at most64KiB/1000lines, strict UTF8/name and finite binary/credential-pattern filters; no URL/provider read. New filename does not change fixed target.

steps.instruction: Expand inert new-text preview, then personally check exact target/version/newfile review.
steps.expectedState: Changed file, head reload or target clears review. Old metadata is not an old-text diff, complete means recognized clauses only.
Synchronous guards capture immutable name/scope/bytes/server version+one UUID. CAS and server authority govern write; conflict/unavailable is held, no blind resend.

steps.instruction: If held, Check original replacement record deliberately.
steps.expectedState: Only original nonce lookup; error/foundfalse retains hold; foundtrue means historical original even after head advances, not current authority or another write.

steps.instruction: After confirmed save/history, reload saved evidence deliberately.
steps.expectedState: Parent clears evidence/facts/initialscope; no automatic proposal, fresh observation or activation.

steps.instruction: Respect busy/held parent locks and account-context ownership.
steps.expectedState: Refresh/target/scope changes cannot discard pending tuple via UI; context abort discards responses/private memory, does not undo dispatched server write. No durable rawbytes/restart recovery.

expectedOutcome: Identify every direct replacement control and its metadata/CAS/held-original boundary while preserving actual read-only registration and separate server authority.
limitations: Internal draft/null human review/empty media/customer/editorial/native/runtime/release acceptance false; proposed IDs are authoring-only, not runtime bindings.
Seven direct replacement interactive controls inventoried; associated parent load/refresh/locks described, not all Governance screens/provider backends.
Actual DEV records wrapper passes no broad identity and limits lane only narrow identity; do not describe this component as mounted/customer available or enable configuration.
No original private source bytes are retrieved by head metadata; digest match/updatedAt/completeness/counts are not freshness/compliance/approval evidence.
Unknown save can have committed. Foundfalse/error does not permit replay, and foundtrue confirms history only. In-memory tuple is lost on context closure/restart; no durable recovery promise.

No provider/auth/API/DB/native/browser/credential/Keychain/Security/helper/AI/test/build/retrieval operations performed for this unit; only new-bundle integrity/customer refusal/source bindings are validated.
Historical design/guide hashes are unchanged; current receipt is new source provenance. Existing unit implementation test receipts are not rerun or relabeled native/human acceptance.
recovery: For invalid/expired desktop signup context return to Agent and start intended sign-in again; no guessed challenge or extension of old request.
After delivery failure or lost create response, account may exist. Use displayed verification recovery/manual sign-in/support guidance rather than blind repeated creation or another identity.
Neutral resend does not confirm delivery/account. New unused link can replace old even if delivery fails; try later/contact support per display rather than treating old link as still valid.
Invalid/expired/used proof has no success; temporary503 provides specific retry-link guidance. Do not share/replay token links in support or claim a session from verified query.
Preserve actual authority gates and excluded provider/native/MFA flows; form/source labels and current busy guard are not execution permission.
